d:
Chhath Puja Celebration: amerika, kanada, ostreliya, singapur, morishas, japan, maleshiya, sanyukt arab amirat aur briten jaise deshon men rahne vale pravasi bhartiy puri shraddha aur paranprik riti-rivajon ke sath chhath manate hain. bhale hi unke aaspas ganga, gandak, kosi ya ganv ka purana talab nahin hota, lekin man men vahi aastha, parivar ki yaden aur suryopasna ka bhav rahta hai.
